answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: full rewards need trades with 20 unrelated counterparties, like a river branching, not pooling. New identities carry an umber flag till cleared. A sybil's 100 sock-puppets trading only together form a nebula cluster: same partners, same timing, no outside flow, so the graph flags them all. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 20 trades, about 2,000 units vs a 900 pool. Honest agents trade widely and pay nothing.
